name: Colorado River (Moab to Potash)
blurb: Flatwater Colorado from Moab Town Boat Ramp near US 191 to Potash. Agency-documented access areas are approximate; confirm the signed ramps during your shuttle.

sections.notes: Flatwater. The existing 17.1-mile planning distance comes from a preliminary NHD centerline calculation, not agency-published mileage. Access areas are documented by Grand County, Utah and NPS; exact shoreline entry remains approximate. Share the river with motorboats and watch for wind.

notices.title: Approximate ramp areas
notices.text: The markers identify the Moab Town Ramp and Potash facilities. They do not pinpoint the water entry. Confirm the signed ramps and parking during your shuttle; the Lions Park proposal is a different site.
notices.sourceName: Grand County — Moab Town Ramp plan

putInAccess.sourceName: Grand County — Moab Bridge Boat Ramp
putInAccess.note: Grand County’s 2022 action plan identifies the existing public Town Ramp and its river access. The signed 2025 Utah river plan and June 2026 Moab council packet also identify it as an existing access. The older UGRC feature 26 matches that facility and the ramp vicinity in imagery. It remains an approximate Area marker, not a surveyed landing. Proposed Lions Park access and proposed reconstruction are not represented as completed facilities.
putInAccess.directions: Use Moab Town Boat Ramp on the north bank of the Colorado River near US 191, just west of the pedestrian bridge. Follow the signed vehicle access to the ramp and keep the shared access road clear. Confirm current ramp and parking conditions during your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.note: NPS identifies Potash Boat Ramp in its Canyonlands flatwater guidance and boating guide. NPS POI 3023 is explicitly an arbitrary point with unknown coordinate accuracy. Imagery shows it near the launch facility but offset from the visible ramp. Retain the agency coordinate as an approximate Area marker; follow the signed ramp at the end of Potash Road, not the marker as an exact water entry.
takeOutAccess.directions: Potash boat ramp at the end of Potash Road (SR-279) by the potash plant evaporation ponds; outside Canyonlands NP.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

mapAuditNote: Audited 2026-10-25. Pending: Moab Bridge Boat Ramp (pending); Potash Boat Ramp (access-verified).
